The CI Orchestrator may record that PASS only as the controller disposition of this adjudicated conflict; it must not rewrite the frozen Q2 diagnostic or invent a fresh Q2 COVERED result.

Current system policy separates role verdicts from controller/task state, assigns one authoritative decision owner at a time, routes material frozen-judgment conflict through Adjudicator, and requires meaningful changed evidence or strategy before retrying a blocked path.

Protocol 2.2 forbids majority-vote resolution, requires controlling rule/evidence and scope reconciliation, routes latent unchanged-scope completeness findings to adjudication, and blocks blind post-exhaustive-Q4 patch loops.
Adjudicator resolves completed-review disagreement by identifying controlling rule/evidence, distinguishing scopes that can both be correct, and refusing compromise merely to satisfy both sides.

Its matrix nevertheless treats generation source/layout/date identity, current/cross-generation replay ownership, documented stable reject-code families, available quantity/weighted valuation, and archive lineage/control/delta positive-path behavior as covered; its five blockers are separately reconciled by closure.

Frozen Q4 Closure Adjudicator is PASS/HIGH/SUFFICIENT and reconciles every final-Q4 blocker exactly once: blanket private-src coupling, expanded movement/item/warehouse case inventory, extra safety/publication subclasses, stronger preflight/audit demands, and corrupt/missing archive-input expansion are rejected scope reopen or latent.

Direct Q2 is explicitly a producer/fixer diagnostic rather than a schema-v3 semantic review. It modifies no task files, reports REPAIR_PROPOSED, and proposes Q2-S01..Q2-S12 across both already-closed scope families and several extra end-to-end/depth variants.

Solver-visible contract explicitly defines source/layout/date generation identity, generation-scoped replay/uniqueness, stable reject-code operational evidence, reconciliation/publication safety, preflight/audit responsibilities, and archive verification/controls/deltas/lineage semantics.

Current verifier contains generation/checkpoint/replay tests, stable reject-code tests plus a helper that checks persisted reject codes against generated reject CSV, weighted-source valuation tests, broad operator workflow perturbations, and independent archive/publication lineage/integrity checks. Q2's disputed scenarios strengthen combinations/depth rather than arise from changed verifier evidence.

Current validator requires controller session rows for Q1/Q2/Q3/Q7 producer gates to have literal status PASS at freeze or later. It does not require the Q2 role-output status itself to equal PASS or COVERED; producer-gate status is controller state. Q4 has a separate explicit adjudicated-closure route.
